acr_recovery_patch.name: OpenClaw Motor Wordflow - ACR Recovery Patch
acr_recovery_patch.objective: Recover OpenClaw as a Wordflow engine without UI using segmented, resumable ACR transfer and forensic audit logging.

segmentation.large_file_policy: do not rewrite source content; mark large objects for special handling

execution_method.forensic_xray_rule: Every output is a transaction checkpoint, not a claim of completion.
before_each_transfer: Resolve the exact next source path from the pinned source commit.
Fetch the complete source content available through the connector.
Record the source SHA and size before writing.
after_each_transfer: Verify destination existence/content against the source record.
Record destination commit and verification status.
Do not advance on a failed or unverified write.
execution_method.segment_audit_rule: When a family or segment boundary is reached, enumerate the source tree for that scope, compare expected paths with destination paths, identify missing/extra items, and only then mark the scope verified.
execution_method.failure_rule: A failed write remains pending and is explicitly logged; it is never silently counted as transferred.
execution_method.restart_rule: After any application/tool restart, reconstruct state only from the GitHub ledger plus this recovery map; never rely on conversational memory alone.

execution_model.continuation_rule: Each family may contain any number of numbered transfer segments.
execution_model.restart_recovery: Read the GitHub ledger first and resume after the last verified output/segment.

recovery_protocol: Never overwrite verified content without recording why.
Record every batch, byte count, source SHA, destination commit and next recovery point.
At family/segment boundaries perform a source-vs-destination inventory audit.
At completion compare reconstructed tree against the pinned source manifest.
